up: List the compounds tested in assays where the target is human amine oxidase B (flavin-containing) and the assay organism is human. For each compound, return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] B'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';
